Worked solution


Here is how to compute the derivatives in this problem.

\(\displaystyle z_t = \frac{\partial{z}}{\partial{x}} \frac{\partial{x}}{\partial{u}} \frac{d{u}}{d{t}} + \frac{\partial{z}}{\partial{y}} \frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{u}} \frac{d{u}}{d{t}} \)

\( \displaystyle \quad= \left[ {@diff_1@} \right] \cdot \left[ {@diff_2@} \right] \cdot \left[ {@diff_3@} \right] + \left[ {@diff_4@} \right] \cdot \left[ {@diff_5@} \right] \cdot \left[ {@diff_6@} \right] \)

\( \displaystyle \quad= {@ta1@}\)

\( \displaystyle z_p = \frac{\partial{z}}{\partial{x}} \frac{\partial{x}}{\partial{p}} + \frac{\partial{z}}{\partial{y}} \frac{\partial{y}}{\partial{p}}\)

\(\displaystyle \quad = \left[ {@diff_1@} \right] \cdot \left[ {@diff_7@} \right] + \left[ {@diff_4@} \right] \cdot \left[ {@diff_8@} \right] \)

\(\displaystyle \quad = {@ta2@} \)
